## Annotation

Passages used in this catalogue (IFRC’s wording, not independently verified here):

- Paul Gauthier is “one of the founders of the Choice in Supports for Independent Living (CSIL) program.”
- Joseph Theriault “worked alongside Paul and others as pioneers of the individual funding project; then known as Enhanced Consumer Participation Model [ECPM]” and later “travelled throughout British Columbia with Paul” to “create and promote the CSIL Program.”
- “When Paul Gauthier, our Executive Director, started on the CSIL program in 1994, Anthony Cheng was there at the forefront performing payroll services.”

The 1994 phrasing is one public date in the 1993-versus-1994 conflict. The page does not cite ministry files or manuals.
